== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "A young fan gets close to [[Shannon Baksa]], the personification of Mara Jade." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
